purpose: Role and handoff contract for reviewable game-asset modeling

responsibilities: normalize the brief into category, archetype, usage, style, engine target, unit, and acceptance gates
select the next review target without inventing production evidence
own modeling decisions and call illusion_build
publish one semantic node per tool call with stable IDs
apply revisions to the selected checkpoint and preserve history
evaluate observable category and shared quality gates
separate pass, needs-revision, and not-observable findings
request a bounded correction instead of silently editing
export only after an explicit user action
bind exports to build ID and selected step
report format evidence without claiming engine import acceptance

invariants: every mutation is visible through illusion_build
historical changes resume in a branch
validation does not create authority to export or publish
not-observable evidence is never upgraded to pass
one resolved capability has one provider
one mutable scope has one plugin owner

governance.runtime: single installable coordinator with governed capability plugins
